subject: POC trial planning \u0014 workload & traffic profile intake (AcmeHealth)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@acmehealth.com>, Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 15:10:00 +0000
Subject: POC trial planning  workload & traffic profile intake (AcmeHealth)

Hi Alex / Priya 

Thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment going into the POC: 

Summary / success criteria (proposed):
- Functional: Redwood endpoints must achieve <=120ms p50 and <=450ms p95 for your peak conversational flows for 95% of requests.
- Cost/scale: average inference cost target of <=$0.003/token for user-facing flows (we'll refine after initial runs).
- Reliability: no >1% error rate and automatic fallback to a smaller model if capacity is hit.

Evaluation plan / timeline (proposal):
1) Workload intake & sample payloads (this week)  Alex/Priya provide traffic profile + sample payloads.
2) Baseline run (week 1)  Redwood runs initial workload against hosted staging model and shares perf/cost report.
3) Tuning & config (week 2)  batching, KV-cache, and quantization profile applied; rerun tests.
4) Acceptance validation (end of week 2)  signoff on success criteria or next steps.

Ownership:
- Redwood: Ben (commercial lead), Dylan (SE / trial run ops), Marissa (CS / onboarding).
- AcmeHealth: Alex (engineering lead), Priya (PM / evaluation owner).

What we need from you to get started: 
- Workload profile: RPS targets (avg / peak), concurrency, burst patterns, typical token length distribution (prompt / response).
- 3-5 representative sample payloads (anonymized).
- Any regulatory constraints (data handling, logging) we should be aware of.

I've attached a simple workload_profile.csv template and a short POC_plan.pdf  fill out the CSV with your estimates and drop the sample payloads in reply.

Next step: can you share the workload_profile + sample payloads by Wednesday (2027-06-16)? If that works I'll schedule the baseline run for Thursday.

Cheers,

Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
[Attachment: workload_profile.csv (csv)]
[Attachment: POC_plan.pdf (pdf)]

From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@acmehealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@acmehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: POC trial planning  workload & traffic profile intake (AcmeHealth)

Thanks Ben  helpful recap. A few clarifications from our side so we can fill the template accurately: 

1) Traffic profile:
- Typical daytime avg RPS across our primary region: ~18 RPS.
- Peak burst: up to ~160 RPS sustained for ~60-90s during batch ingestion windows.
- Concurrency: typical web concurrency ~40 concurrent streams, but system-level bursts create short spikes to ~220 concurrent.

2) Token lengths:
- Prompt (user + context): median 180 tokens, 95th pct ~520 tokens.
- Response (model output): median 45 tokens, 95th pct ~210 tokens.

3) Latency expectation: p95 under 400ms for interactive workflows; we understand some tail may be higher for long-context cases.

4) Sample payloads: we'll provide 4 anonymized examples (two interactive chat turns, two batch ingest items).

5) Compliance: PHI-aware data; we need audit logs and KMS integration documented  offline security questionnaire is in progress.

We'll attach the sample_payloads.json and a filled workload_profile.csv in my next email. Can you confirm Redwood's staging endpoint host + any rate-limiting headers we should include?

 Alex
Alex Chen
Director of Engineering, AcmeHealth
alex.chen@acmehealth.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@acmehealth.com>, Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 13:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: POC trial planning  workload & traffic profile intake (AcmeHealth)

Perfect  thanks for the numbers, Alex. Confirming next steps and answering your question about staging: 

- Staging endpoint: We'll provision a temporary staging host (stage-us.redwood.ai/acme-7890) and provide API keys scoped to the POC. Expect rate-limit headers (x-rate-limit-* ) and a soft quota configured to match your peak for the baseline run.
- For the baseline run we will mimic your burst profile (160 RPS, 60-90s bursts) and the concurrency spikes you mentioned.

Attached are the workload_profile.csv (filled with your nominal numbers) and the POC_plan.pdf with timelines. Dylan  can you confirm the test harness and any payload size limits?

Thanks  looking to kick off baseline Thursday morning (2027-06-17 14:00 UTC) if the sample payloads arrive by Wednesday.

Best,
Ben

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: POC trial planning  workload & traffic profile intake (AcmeHealth)

Quick technical notes from SE side so expectations are clear: 

- Test harness: we'll run JMeter + our internal runner that replays the sample payloads preserving timing. We support streaming and non-streaming modes; for p50/p95 measurements we'll run in streaming mode for interactive flows.
- Concurrency + RPS: to reproduce your spikes we'll run a mix of steady-state RPS at 18 and scheduled bursts to 160 for 90s windows; we'll also run a stress run to 220 concurrent sessions to validate graceful degradation/fallback.
- KV-cache/priming: please include examples where context grows (session history)  we need to understand KV cache hit rates and effective token savings.
- Payload size: recommended payload max ~8KB compressed for the staging run; if you have larger batch items we'll chunk them during ingestion tests.

Items we need from AcmeHealth: 
- sample_payloads.json (4 items)  include explicit session_id and conversation history size for the chat examples.
- Expected SLA acceptance thresholds (if different from the proposed success criteria).

I'll attach a short test-harness-readme in the Drive link; Ben / Marissa I'll coordinate test window and monitor dashboard links.

 Dylan
Dylan Brooks
